frequency_question: Among historical instances where large confederations threatened or scheduled industry-wide indefinite strikes, what proportion actually proceeded without calling it off or delaying within the final two-week window?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide strike notices by multi-union coalitions in major economies where a specific final deadline for an indefinite strike was set; excludes single-employer localized strikes or wildcat actions without formal federation notice.
window: 12-day forward window leading up to strike deadline

validity_reason: Labor dispute resolution dynamics and union-state negotiation patterns evolve slowly over decades.
